note: Alberta Parks recreation-area campground at the northern Chain Lakes near Athabasca (not Chain Lakes Provincial Park on Hwy 22 in the south), a 40-minute drive from Athabasca. Treed sites, a picnic shelter, a boat launch and a fish-cleaning station. --Claude
